notes.title: UPDATE V0.8
notes.notes:
Trial Rooms

7 new Trial rooms

Sword Room

You must defeat all other souls using your sword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/94c538e98887644b21168bf16345e4aa4968ca17.png

Axe Room

You must defeat all other souls by throwing your axes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/44c0a5a13d3e0a0b2f1eb538d12d27220292358d.png

Death God Room

You must not be touched by the Death God, be careful he can be invisible and becomes faster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/2d292fd8734748ca6a1c0c77b7660e31be555c7f.png

Damocles Room

You must touch the other souls to avoid the consequences of Damocles' sword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/6825b1ca7dd5890e9bfddec1b711b67567d5b1c5.png

Lost Torch Room

You must keep the torch until the end of the allotted time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/b47c75c04f936ec4642608afeed49923dc5b7fd6.png

Creature Room

You must not be touched by the creatures, you can eliminate them with your sword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/49da1380e1d77e6b7cd7b2e1652735e170c6ed65.png

Labyrinth Room

You must find the fastest way to retrieve the torch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/17fd6ac3eadd46275c550e1d700603b4e859c6b2.png

Special Rooms

Resurrection Room

You can resurrect a member of your sacrificed team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/b06de78941291e71589c5f0f053e08702950db63.png

Purification Room

You can purify a soul, in order to remove all its penalties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/654bd8845bc837d9a909780fbe3a4951c67c3f94.png

The prayer room

You can pick up a clue by praying.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/fb30c89891612fd77780324a70fae56fb9fd1cb5.png

The informant's room

The informant reveals information about a member of your team, be careful he tends to lie...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/b739207de1586b00dc55ab3c2e953485bfed5d70.png


Imposter Items

Invisibility Potion

Allows the Corrupted Soul to turn invisible, can also turn a teammate invisible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/6230393c9566dcf9a306e61f6835211757e1f11f.png

Satanic Knife

Allows Corrupted Soul to Sacrifice a Lost Soul

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/72371b201455b74b01fa7808f1ef4a398a3b4657.png

Satanic Book

Allows the corrupted soul to curse a wandering soul (a cursed soul only sees false distances when exploring)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/42b27f62a8a65381e0b75622de1af717a1f1af22.png

notes.title: Update V0.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we have the honor to present you this new update, we hope that you will like! we have tried to mix your feedback and our desires :)

 New text chat system 

You can now communicate with the whole team using text chat :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/92f7b1e81fc4dea3ba8023545a97dcaf5a3aec1f.png

You can also use a parallel chat only visible to Corrupted Souls! this will allow you to strategize without getting caught.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/7852baa5c7a967dc7215b29653e85770b9928b2a.png

 Matchmaking 

You can now find a game with players who are not necessarily your friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/b36569a24f8f4fb3d9a99e0cda835b56aed94dd0.png

Matchmaking games are limited to 6 players, and you can  use the chat to communicate.

  Special Rooms 

During your game you can find special rooms on the way with special new mechanics.

 Chests Room 

You have two chests in front of you, one chest gives you a reward and the other a penalty, you have to try to find the right chest knowing that the corrupted souls know which one is trapped.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/8462aa6211a13771bac50aa120d4adaf375bee91.png

 Sacrifice Room 

The sacrifice room allows you to sacrifice a member of your team in order to have an additional key in exchange.

This room uses a voting system, the player with the most votes after time runs out will be sacrificed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/61de44c7d8a31b01fd687be300bfb1fbd826a71b.png

 The Gargoyle Room  

In this room you must dodge the fireballs as long as possible knowing that they appear step by step and bounce off the walls, if you are the last survivor of this ordeal you will be rewarded with an exploration of your choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/3239d715f19b3da04baaf6ca54fc6a3aa74f066d.png

  New Corrupted Soul Powers 

Corrupted souls now have the option to trap a room of their choice with the power they randomly received at the start of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/f4cdfd3f7f7b57845c8686917ab1d7b900b2c4f0.png

 Curse Room   

The curse power allow to curse a room, a cursed room will open a random door regardless of the players will

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/922633082eb2d68cbfadc6b051c3c5bc910f1a72.png

  Power of fog  

The fog power allows you to fog a room, a foggy room allows you to hide the distance when a player is exploring in this same room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/aea75333c68a10ca887fa61d4ca006144fd54104.png

 Power of imprisonment 

The Power of Imprisonment allows you to imprison a player who explores this room, when a player is imprisoned he can be released at any time by the team.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/526b61021fcf8f4b82df4d838bc672b0633dbbb7.png



  Global Gameplay Balancing 

From now on an algorithm analyzes the characteristics of the dungeon at each game and gives a number of keys and torches accordingly.


 Improved ergonomics 

From now on, to launch an event, you must interact with objects :


This object allows the team leader to launch an exploration : 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/7e12bc2c0aa8fd40509daf996c6d079a513dc70f.png

This item allows the team leader to cast a door open vote : 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/ee83cbd6a99cc2511b3b97044c516c95a0e70e51.png

This item allows you to access the dungeon map :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/4504063db1c06ce62c27c5eb06dc450db994658f.png

This object allows you to request a new team leader : 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252023/f6e5d88ca39f07949d59215c6cad8d6c3603c2ab.png

 Cross platform mobile  

You can now play with players on mobile, IOS and Android
